column11: BNP 3Q26 results press release, Paris 28 Oct 2026 (invest.bnpparibas/en/document/3q26-pr, PRIMARY, read 10/29)
column12: CoR EUR964m (+EUR59m vs 3Q25 EUR905m) = 39bp of customer loans, 'in line with the guidance of less than 40 basis points for 2026' (guidance UNCHANGED). Release gives no 3Q25 bp. ⚠️ NO GROUP NII LINE in the press release or the 3Q26 appendices - NII is shown only per division ('incl. net interest revenue'). NOT summed: building a group NII from divisions after seeing the numbers is a post-hoc construction the frozen rules forbid. Row is therefore INCOMPLETE on NII by design, not by omission - owed: find a bank-published group NII (quarterly financial statements) or record BNP as ungradeable. Group revenues 13,757 vs 12,569 (+9.5%), context only. French sovereign holdings ~EUR19bn (16bn at amortised cost) per the release.

Q3 includes CRE de-risking (accelerated NPL exits) and 'an idiosyncratic event in Corporate Bank' - graded AS REPORTED, not adjusted. ⚠️ GUIDANCE CELL IS A JUDGEMENT: the release now says all-in PCL 'in the second half of 2026 to be similar to the first half' (H1 = 979m) while 'underlying provisions' stay 'consistent with the bank's guidance of slightly lower compared with the prior year'. Verify before HNS-09 grades.
